Hi Sara / Tom —

Thanks again for your time today. Quick recap from our discovery and the options I recommended so we have alignment before next steps: 

Summary of needs from your call:
- High throughput embedding and chat endpoints for customer-facing search and summarization (peak QPS estimated ~120).
- Data residency requirement: US-only processing and 30-day retention for inference logs.
- Security: SOC2 and ability to integrate with your KMS for key management.
- Budget: procurement expects a 6–9 month runway for pilot + procurement review.

Recommended deployment path (based on the above):
1) Redwood Dedicated (reserved GPU pool) for pilot to meet throughput and latency SLAs — predictable performance and easier autoscale for spikes.
2) Optionally, Private/VPC (customer-managed VPC) if procurement requires full network isolation and on-prem/KMS integration for production.

Immediate next steps we proposed on the call:
- I’ll share a short one-pager comparing Dedicated vs Private for your infra/security team (attached).
- If you’re still aligned, schedule a 60-min technical kickoff with your infra + security folks to walk architecture and data-flow (I suggested a few windows).
- Procurement: I’ll attach a draft SOW + MSA template and an estimated pilot budget band so procurement can triage.

Attachments I’m including: redwood-dedicated-vs-private-onepager.pdf (summary) and MAP-Apex-Questions.xlsx (our intake for pilot requirements).

Can you confirm: is the procurement timeline you mentioned (6–9 months) still accurate, and would you like the technical kickoff this month or early next? If helpful, here’s my calendar link: https://calendly.com/redwood/karthik-30m

Thanks — looking forward to moving this to the technical phase when you’re ready.

Best,
Karthik Iyer

   - Typical: $75k (recommended for peak QPS and buffer)
   - High: $120k (includes burst capacity and extended tracing/retention)

Next steps I propose:
- I’ll share an editable MSA + SOW by EOB today (link above).
- Technical kickoff: Wed 30 Sep or Thu 1 Oct, 60 mins. Please confirm which works and which of your infra/security folks should be on the call.
